protocol.question: Does shared two-block IQP predict joint-coupling extrapolation from finite axis samples, and beat strong classical predictors?
protocol.unused: Other five 4x4-grid points never generated or used
protocol.initialization: data_initialize on pooled7000training samples, complete_ansatz8 generators, all36 parameters; seed('initial',rep)

iqp.modes: sampled all3seeds; population two_block_branch seed0 only
iqp.selection: argmin mean empirical validationTVD across7trainingconditions, all CampaignTrainingResult checkpoints includinginitial; no testtarget access
iqp.postprocessing: also evaluate arithmetic average of product IQP outputs under masks0,15,240,255; no reselection

classical.histogram_selection: single lambda minimizes mean validation cross-entropy over all7trainingconditions; first in ascending grid breaks ties
classical.composition: log q(a,b)=log q(a,.1)+log q(.1,b)-log q(.1,.1), then logsumexp normalization
classical.nearest: unsmoothed symmetry-aware training histograms, Euclidean nearest training point, average ties at absolute tolerance1e-12
classical.loglinear: q(o|a,b)=softmax([1,(a-.1)/.6,(b-.1)/.6] @ W), orbit0 reference logit0, remaining63x3 free coefficients
classical.loglinear_objective: mean per-observation training orbit negative log-likelihood over all7conditions + (lambda/2)*sum(W**2), includes interceptpenalty
classical.loglinear_selection: minimum unpenalized mean validation orbit NLL over7conditions; first ascending lambda breaks ties
classical.solver: scipy L-BFGS-B analyticgradient, independent zero initialization for eachlambda, ftol1e-12,gtol1e-8,maxiter10000,maxls50; must succeed and gradient infinitynorm<=1e-6. If needed continue samecandidate with sameobjective maxiter50000. If unresolved, baseline invalid and no predictive-advantage claim

protocol.test_sealing: fit all7IQPmodels and all3classicalmodelsets; save modelparams, predictions at train/test coordinates and validation choices; SHA256seal everyartifact before firsttesttarget computation

gate.absolute: each seed mean testTVD<=.15, worst testTVD<=.25, worst connectedRMSE<=.10
gate.advantage: across3seeds mean pairedTVD improvement>=.02 versus each mandatory sample-trained classicalbaseline AND positive improvement in each seed; all classicalfits must be valid
gate.if_classical_wins: stop; no gap widening or tuning; record encoding vs predictive-advantage distinction

protocol.optional_target_aware_fits: not scheduled; no test-aware optimization in this screen
protocol.exact_composition: analytic axis distributions reconstructed by logcomposition should match finaltest law to numericalprecision; privileged diagnostic only

checks: frozen prediction hashes unchanged after scoring
test predictions independently re-evaluated at correct angles
all11 evaluated target laws checked against scalar energies
training Fourier vectors checked against explicit parities
orbit expansion and axis log-composition identities
